verdict.rationale: Gitea ships a substantial first-party REST API. Every instance publishes a 342-path Swagger/OpenAPI spec under /api/v1 and an interactive Swagger UI, alongside an official go-sdk and the tea CLI. However, no evidence documents or verifies that the API reaches parity with everything the UI can do, and some UI-side areas such as dynamic admin config are described only as panel operations. missing for 10: an explicit vendor statement or audit of API/UI feature parity, independent hands-on corroboration of parity, and API coverage evidence for admin configuration and other UI-only areas.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
